message.content:
A vertical rectangular image shows a magazine cover with a black background and red borders on the left and bottom edges. At the top, the red word "TEMPO" is centered in large, bold, serif font. Below it, small white text reads "EDISI 7-13 MEI 2012". Above the main title, smaller white text sections are separated by vertical lines: "MAIN SABUN BBM BERSUBSIDI", a small square portrait of a person with dark hair and glasses, "MENGINTIP ANGIE DI RUTAN KPK", and "MEMBURU NENENG DI PELARIAN".

The center features large, three-tiered text. The top line in gray reads "CERITA DARI". The middle line in larger gray reads "KAMPUNG". The bottom line is the largest, in white, textured block letters: "NARKOBA". A thin black horizontal line cuts through the center of the white letters. On the right, a hand's fingers hold a rolled-up red and white paper tube, positioned as if to draw the black line through the letters.

Below, white text states: "BERTAHUN-TAHUN KAMPUNG AMBON MENJADI PASAR NARKOTIK DI IBU KOTA. KUAT DIDUGA APARAT TERLIBAT." The bottom left includes "RP 29.700", website and publication info, and a white barcode box.
